about: Wave G1 DATA (item 2.4): the state of every city gate in the model and of the Xiaguan boats by time, with status (核实 / 推测 / 未核实 / 争议) and source on every interval. Intervals are contiguous: { from, to, state, status, source, note? } with from inclusive and to exclusive, local time (+08:00), from 1937-12-01T00:00 to 1938-01-31T23:59. Gate states and times come from timeline.json gates (timeline.py) and wall.json; where they disagree the row says so in note and the top-level conflicts list. Nothing here is drawn by this file: it is read by the overlay (mods/battles_overlay.js).

half_open.text: Only half of the gate is passable.

narrow.text: A narrow lane kept through the sandbags.

breached.mark: cross (the wall beside or at the gate is broken, the gate is still held)
breached.text: Wall broken at or beside the gate; still Chinese-held.

taken.text: Held by the Japanese army (from the first hour it is taken; stays so to the end).

closed_long.text: Bricked up long before 1937: never an exit, not counted.

water_arch.text: Arch over a stream in the wall; not a gate people use.

counter.rule: N = number of entries of gates[] (not water_gates) whose state at the story time has states[state].exit = true (open, half_open, narrow). Water arches and closed_long gates are never counted.
counter.note: The scene's wickets (Tongji, Shuixi: a 1.38 m way, 推测) are NOT counted; see the two gates' note.

sealing_window.status: 核实 (the event); per-gate days 推测
sealing_window.source: timeline ev-1206-gates-sealed (英文维基 Battle of Nanking: by December 6 all gates blocked); the model flips every gate at 12-05 18:00
sealing_window.note: Inside this window the gates are being sealed but the table (like the wall.json of the scene) still has the usable ones open until 12-05 18:00, so the counter reads 19 at 12-05 12:00. The overlay may print "Gates being sealed" instead of N inside the window.

siege.rule: Before 12-09 00:00 local: show the date only. From 12-09 00:00 to 12-13 04:00: "Day n of the siege", n = calendar day since 12-09 (12-09 = Day 1, 12-12 = Day 4, 12-13 before 04:00 = Day 5). From 12-13 04:00 (hud.js FALL): "The city has fallen" and the hud DAY counter (DAY 1 = 12-13).
siege.source: Day 1 = 12-09: timeline ev-1209-guanghua-battle (first clash at the gate at dawn, 核实) and ev-1209-leaflets (the surrender ultimatum is dropped, 核实). The word "siege" and the start day are this table's choice, not a source's.

boats_rule: Draw one boat icon at xiaguan-ferries.at (中山码头, x/z given): coloured while its state is present, grey while removed. xiaguan-small-craft (icon false) may be drawn as a smaller second icon at the Xiaguan piers; xiaguan-train-ferry is never drawn (gone since before the attack).
